channel.title: AI Threat Watch: TH
channel.description: Verified case files located in TH.

item.title: [HIGH] Bangkok police bust Chinese gang animating victims' photos with AI to beat bank KYC checks
item.description: Metropolitan Police Division 5 arrested four Chinese nationals in a Sukhumvit condo who used AI to turn victims' still photos into blinking, head-turning videos that passed bank KYC liveness checks for criminal networks. Target: Thai banks' KYC and account-opening systems. TH. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Thai police arrest two from Poipet gang using AI face-altering to pose as police
item.description: Thai police arrested two members of a Poipet, Cambodia call centre that used AI to alter faces on video calls while posing as police; 163 victims, including Charlotte Austin who lost 4 million baht (about $118,000). Target: Thai residents including beauty queen Charlotte Austin. TH. Verification: confirmed.
